intro: A Duskbat Wing is a raw material harvested from the leather-winged bats flitting through the gloom around Deathknell. In the resource-starved Forsaken settlement, these leathery appendages are salvaged and repurposed by local tailors into sturdy makeshift armor for newly risen soldiers.

p: When new undead claw their way from the soil of Deathknell, they emerge bearing little more than rags and brittle bones. Surrounded by the lingering Scourge mindless and hostile wildlife, the fledgling Forsaken must scrape together whatever protective gear they can find. Novice Elreth, assistant to Shadow Priest Sarvis, collects Duskbat Wings alongside wolf paws to piece together and reinforce clothing and armor for freshly raised warriors before they are sent into the wilderness to fight.
